advisories.query: Should I irrigate my cotton field today?
advisories.advice_summary: PAUSE PUMPS. Soil moisture is adequate (0.24 m³/m³) and 12mm rain is forecasted. Skipping irrigation will conserve ~4,500 liters of water.

advisories.query: Will the high humidity cause fungal leaf spot on cotton?
advisories.advice_summary: MODERATE THREAT. Relative humidity exceeds 82% with 27°C temperature, creating prime conditions for Alternaria leaf spot. Apply preventative copper oxychloride or bio-fungicide before rain arrives.
